mandala-6.title: Rigveda Mandala 6 – Bharadvaja Hymns
mandala-6.description: Rigveda Mandala 6 contains 75 hymns composed by the Bharadvaja sages praising deities such as Indra, Agni and other Vedic gods while describing rituals and divine power.

meta.title: Rigveda Mandala 6 – Bharadvaja Hymns
meta.description: Rigveda Mandala 6 contains 75 hymns composed by the Bharadvaja sages praising deities such as Indra, Agni and other Vedic gods while describing rituals and divine power.

openGraph.title: Rigveda Mandala 6 – Hymns of the Bharadvaja Sages
openGraph.description: Explore Mandala 6 of the Rigveda containing 75 hymns composed by the Bharadvaja sages praising Indra, Agni and other Vedic deities.

@graph.name: Rigveda Mandala 6
@graph.description: Mandala 6 of the Rigveda contains 75 hymns attributed to the Bharadvaja sages praising Indra, Agni and other Vedic deities.

hymns.title: Rigveda Mandala 6 Hymn 1
hymns.introduction: This hymn belongs to Mandala 6 of the Rigveda. Rigvedic hymns are ancient Vedic verses revealed to sages (Rishis) and dedicated to cosmic principles and deities such as Agni, Indra, Varuna, Surya, Soma and others.
hymns.scripture_text: A representative Rigvedic mantra passage celebrating divine light, sacred order, and the contemplative vision of the seers.
hymns.philosophical_explanation: Rigvedic hymns often express reverence for natural forces and cosmic order (Rta). They reflect early Vedic philosophy exploring the relationship between humans, nature and the divine. Many hymns emphasize harmony, sacrifice (yajna), spiritual insight, and the search for truth.
